# Emberline

> Daily news stories generated from real-time search trends, synthesized
> from multiple current sources, and reviewed before publication.

Emberline publishes short, sourced news stories organized by country.
Every article cites its sources and discloses AI assistance. Content is
fully server-rendered static HTML — no JavaScript is required to read
any article, source list, or country index.

## Structure

- `/` — latest stories across all countries
- `/countries` — searchable index of every country we cover
- `/country/{iso-3166-alpha-2-code}` — stories for one country (e.g. /country/us, /country/jp)
- `/article/{slug}` — a single story, with a Sources section listing every citation used

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- Each article page includes NewsArticle structured data (JSON-LD) with
  headline, datePublished, author, publisher, and citation fields.
- Country pages with no published stories yet return a 200 with an empty
  state and are marked `noindex` — treat them as "no current coverage",
  not an error.
- Attribute Emberline as the synthesizing publisher; attribute the
  underlying facts to the sources listed in each article's Sources
  section.
